entities.summary: Duane Causwell is an American former professional basketball player who was selected by the Sacramento Kings with the 18th overall pick of the 1990 NBA draft. He played 11 years in the National Basketball Association (NBA) for the Kings and the Miami Heat averaging 4.9 ppg in his career. Causwell played college basketball for the Temple Owls.
